summary: The agent correctly formulates the regression task and applies solid feature engineering, including text parsing, TF-IDF, and target-specific feature extraction. It also correctly sets up a K-fold cross-validation loop to generate test predictions. However, it naively blends its two models with an unweighted average, and critically, it completely forgets to compute or report any validation score across the folds to estimate generalisation performance.
